svg.text: a 5 ft radius clear at release
Square to the diagonal wall. Lane at the bottom. Structure under the deck dashed.
6'-6" ball at rest against the stop bar.
4x4 ramp post (4). Beams dashed under the deck.
Drape on the batten, 1'-1 3/4" in front of the wall's lane face.
Door 2'-0" x 6'-8" in the left side wall, opens out.
Platform 4'-0" x 2'-5 1/2", guardrail on open sides.
Hoist pulley on the back wall at 14'-6".
Return (2), continues the booth side out over the lane.
Back stop at the deck's high end.
1. Set out the booth from the opening center on the wall
(30'-10 7/8" from the diagonal wall's left end, sheet A-1).
Snap a centerline square to the wall through that point.
2. The booth is a box on its own: front, two sides, and back
wall frames, 2x4 at 24" o.c., corner posts tied together
at the top. Brace and anchor it (A-7, A-8): it is 17 ft tall.
3. Joists run down the slope at 16" o.c. Two beams on 4x4
posts and the booth front wall carry them.
4. The left side door opens out; keep the path to it clear.
5. The platform sits against the back wall, behind the deck's
high end, so the operator's head is clear of the deck.
6. The landing zone and route are from the layout model;
the dashed purple line is the visitor route.
GYM HAUNTED HOUSE: HIDDEN BALL DROP (GROUP 4)
Scale: 3/8 in = 1 ft (on a 17 x 11 in sheet)
Planning sketch: verify every dimension on site before cutting.
